{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|But I'm not without a heart. Ooops! My mistake&hellip;I am without a heart!|8t88, to Kyle Katarn|audio=NotWOAHeart-JKDFII.flac|<ref name="DFRA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Heart.png|thumb|150px|A heart]]
The '''heart''' was a major internal organ found in many [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures and [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was responsible for pumping [[Blood/Legends|blood]] through the blood vessels. Any strikes or damage done to the heart was usually [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to humanoids.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> The [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by the name of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], for instance, had once pulled the beating heart out of a warrior, and took a bite out of it, he then shared it with his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], on the other hand, killed [[Gender/Legends|her]] brother, [[Darth Caedus]], by striking at his heart with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Over a thousand years earlier, Dessel&mdash;the boy who would become [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]&mdash;killed his own father, [[Hurst]], by using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] to crush the man's heart.<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> The heart of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] being was located behind the breastbone, and would thud against it under certain emotional conditions.<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Some species, such as the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], had two hearts, which had to beat in synchronization to function properly,<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> while the Muun had three hearts. [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]] also had a secondary heart to support their large [[Brain/Legends|brains]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] had two hearts, but would die in three days if one of the them failed.<ref name="Queen of the Empire">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref> The [[Atoan]] species did not possess hearts, but rather had numerous "hearts" throughout their bodies.<ref name="TLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>

In terms of medical treatment, there were several devices which could monitor the heart, such as the various monitors and defibrillators used by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to monitor the status of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] following his horrific ordeal on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Medical personnel used a device called an [[auscultator]] to listen to the heart sounds of their patients, as [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kornell Divini]] did to [[Memah Roothes]] on board the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
A failing heart could also be replaced by a more healthy one through a delicate surgical [[Heart transplant|procedure]].<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons" />

For many, the heart was also thought of as the seat of emotion. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] once told an [[Unidentified extra-galactic spacer|extra-galactic spacer]] they had the heart of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="JGG">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref> When young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] asked [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]] if they would ever see each other again, she responded, "What does your heart tell you?"<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was pleased to see [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] survive an assassination attempt, telling her that it brought warm feelings to his heart.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], Padmé told Anakin that he was breaking her heart after witnessing him turning to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> Hearts were also a symbol of love. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] named [[Kyoopid]] sported heart-like symbols on his body. The celebration also saw symbolic representations of the heart on love cards, as sculptures, as [[Chak heart]]s, or as the tip of an [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]] on [[Ewok Festival of Love Crossbow|certain crossbows]]<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
